name: frontend-design
title_zh: 先问「这界面在替谁说话」再动手的视觉设计陪练
tagline_zh: 受够了千篇一律的 Tailwind 模板脸？它逼你交代每个间距、字重、配色背后的意图。
tagline_en: Tired of cookie-cutter template faces? It forces you to justify every spacing, weight, and hue until your UI has.
desc_en: Guidance for distinctive, intentional visual design when building new UI or reshaping an existing one. Helps with aesthetic direction, typography, and making choices that don't read as templated defaults.
why_zh: 不是给调色盘或字体库，而是把「为什么这么选」变成硬性关卡。每一步都追问视觉决策的动机。
why_en: Not a palette or font picker—it turns 'why this choice' into a mandatory gate, pushing you past framework-default aesthetics.
limit_zh: 只作用于视觉方向与风格决策，不生成代码、不检查可访问性对比度、不覆盖动效或交互逻辑。需要你已有明确的设计目标或待改界面。
limit_en: Only guides visual direction & style choices—no code, no contrast checks, no motion/UX logic. Requires an existing UI or clear design goal to act on.
title_en: A visual design coach that asks who your UI speaks for.
